limits: Original source-informed broad sculpture interpretation, not an exact artwork replica. Yelton centre, ground and top are retained; wing span and relief proportions are photo estimates. Existing portal centres, source beam slope, source base geometry and collision stay unchanged. Face depth and small colour shapes are estimates. The southwest portal remains unplaced and is not counted. No source photo is a runtime texture.
